description: This file contains a script that polls a backend health endpoint before starting a frontend development server, including environment variable controls and retry logic.

methods.name: _truthy
methods.description: Converts a value to a boolean based on common true indicators.

methods.name: _healthcheckDisabled
methods.description: Checks environment variables to determine if backend health checks are disabled.

methods.name: _getNumberEnv
methods.description: Retrieves a numeric environment variable with a default fallback.

methods.name: waitForBackendHealth
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for the backend /health endpoint to return HTTP 200 or times out.
